subject: Lumina Therapeutics — Implementation deliverables, acceptance criteria, and network convergence plan
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@luminatherapeutics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lumina Therapeutics — Implementation deliverables, acceptance criteria, and network convergence plan

Hi Alex / team,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Per our alignment, I pulled together the initial implementation deliverables and a concise acceptance checklist so we can close the preflight gating items before scheduling the appliance shipment and on-prem install window. Attached: lumina-network-diagram-v3.pdf (updated peering + private endpoint layout), onprem-kit-inventory.xlsx (recommended kit and power/network cabling notes), and acceptance-criteria-v1.md.

High-level asks from Redwood:
- Confirm VPC CIDR ranges and the BGP ASN you plan to use for the direct connect / transit (we've flagged potential overlap on 10.1.0.0/16).
- Confirm which subnets will host the private endpoints and the NAT/egress policy for telemetry to our control plane.
- Sign-off on the attached acceptance criteria so our CS and Install teams can schedule the 4-day on-prem package install window (target week of Dec 6).

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Lumina confirms CIDR/ASN and egress policy (deadline: Tue 11/16 COB).
2) Redwood schedules deep-dive with infra owners (45–60m) to validate diagram + ports + firewall rules.
3) Ship on-prem package (hardware or appliance image) and confirm onsite engineer dates.

If helpful, Grace will run the deep-dive and Irene will hold the acceptance checklist review. Ben / Marissa — please hold tentative slots for the week of Dec 6 for install and a 2-hour staging window the day before.

Alex — can you confirm who from ITOps will own the CIDR/ASN confirmation?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment(s): lumina-network-diagram-v3.pdf (diagram), onprem-kit-inventory.xlsx (spreadsheet), acceptance-criteria-v1.md (markdown)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@luminatherapeutics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lumina ITOps <itops@luminatherapeutics.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lumina Therapeutics — Implementation deliverables, acceptance criteria, and network convergence plan

Camila — thanks for the summary and the artifacts. Sanjay (ITOps) is looping in to confirm specifics. Quick answers inline: 

- CIDR / ASN: We will use 10.10.0.0/16 for the Lumina VPCs serving private endpoints; ASN will be 64520. We will not be able to change the existing CIDR until after a maintenance window, so we need Redwood to support the plan with the current ranges.
- Private endpoints: We'll host endpoints in the app-tier subnets in us-west-2a/b; egress to Redwood control plane must be allowed via a managed NAT plus explicit firewall rules to redwood-control.redwood.com (IPs included in attached diagram).
- Acceptance: Reviewing now; we expect to have internal sign-off Friday 11/19.

Sanjay — can you confirm the firewall / transit constraints and whether we require a proxy for telemetry?

Best,
Alex
Director, Cloud Platform
Lumina Therapeutics

--

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@luminatherapeutics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@luminatherapeutics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lumina Therapeutics — Implementation deliverables, acceptance criteria, and network convergence plan

Camila / team — quick follow-up from ITOps after reviewing the diagram. A couple items to flag: 

- We have an existing transit gateway that owns 10.10.0.0/16 prefixes; we cannot carve additional /24s without an overlap risk. We can either: (a) use a NAT-proxy in a dedicated subnet and perform DNAT for the appliance, or (b) Redwood can host a small transit VIF that terminates into our VPC with route filters. We prefer option (b) for cleaner routing.
- Firewall rules: We have a managed perimeter that requires an approved IP allowlist. Can Redwood provide a stable set of egress IPs for the control plane and the appliance (or a documented proxy endpoint)?
- Telemetry: For compliance we need telemetry proxied through our internal collector; Redwood's agent needs to be allowed to send to collector.lumina.local:443.

We'll confirm formally by EOD Thursday 11/18.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Cloud Operations
Lumina Therapeutics

--

Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 15:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lumina Therapeutics — Implementation deliverables, acceptance criteria, and network convergence plan

Hi Sanjay / Alex —

Thanks for the clear notes. Option (b) (Redwood-hosted VIF + route filters) is workable; we'll run the transit VIF design in the technical deep-dive and confirm the prefix filters required. Two quick asks before the deep-dive: 

1) Sanjay — can you share the transit gateway ASN and the control-plane allowlist requirements (IP ranges / FQDNs) so we can pre-seed the firewall request with your security team?
2) Alex — assuming we agree on the VIF termination, can Lumina confirm a preferred 2-day staging window (we recommend Dec 2–3) and a 4-day install window (Dec 6–9) for the on-prem package? We'll hold tentative travel for our field engineer pending your acceptance doc.

I'll send a calendar invite for a 60-minute technical deep-dive (proposed Thu 11/18 10:00 PT) and include an agenda: transit VIF design, prefix filters, private endpoint NAT behavior, and acceptance checklist walkthrough.

Camila / Irene — please add any acceptance checklist items that require CS sign-off. Ben / Marissa — please confirm you have the install slots tentatively blocked.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
